title: The Goal: A Process of Ongoing Improvement
author: Eliyahu M. Goldratt
summary: Told as a novel, it follows plant manager Alex Rogo, given three months to rescue his failing factory, as a physicist mentor teaches him to find and manage the bottlenecks that limit output.
readIf: you want to learn operations and the theory of constraints through a story.
skipIf: you want rich fiction or a modern take on software and service work.
